output.recommendation: Require pre-deployment validation of AI-driven ML model updates through a sandbox environment, as defined by ITU-T Y.3172, and mandate an AI-incident interface from the ML pipeline to authorities, similar to the architecture specified in ITU-T Y.3181.
output.rationale: [G1] [G2] Emphasizing pre-deployment validation ensures model reliability before live network integration, while establishing a standard incident reporting mechanism enhances transparency and accountability during AI operations.
